full_judgment: 3. The plaintiff's case, in short, is that, the plaintiff availed loan facility from the branch of the defendant No. 1-Bank, and still there is transaction between the plaintiff and the said branch of the defendant No. 1 but the plaintiff did not mortgage his land against the said loan and did not make himself guarantor for any loan sanctioned in favour of any other person. On 15-7-2001, the plaintiff came to know from an employee of the defendant No. 1 at Kapi-Imunirhat that the defendant No. 1 obtained an ex-parte decree against him. On hearing the same, the plaintiff rushed to Khulna and applied for inspection through an advocate and on 22-7-2001 for the first time came to know about the said ex-parte judgment and decree. The plaintiff has already applied for the certified copy of the judgment and decree but hurriedly filed the instant suit apprehending that in the meantime, the defendant No. 1 Bank may take action against him. It has also been stated that in the Artha Rin Suit No. 35 of 1996 this plaintiff was impleaded as defendant No. 3. Though the defendant No. 3 of the present suit is that son of plaintiff's full brother but they are living separately. The plaintiff has no manner of relationship with the defendant No. 3. As both of them are co-sharers in the same jama a single khatian is prepared in their names but they separated their lands by amicable partition since long. The plaintiff has no connection with the business of the defendant No. 3 Decree in Artha Rin Suit No. 35 of 1996 obtained in collusion with the defendant No. 3 and some dishonest employees of the defendant No. 1 by creating forged document in the name of the plaintiff. It has been further stated that no notice was served upon the plaintiff. Registered notice dated 20-9-1995 was also not served upon the plaintiff and he did not sign the acknowledgement receipt. The plaintiff is a simple cultivator and most of the time resides in his house. Notice of the final decree was received by the defendant No. 3 but he did not inform the plaintiff about the notice. Everything was done keeping the plaintiff in dark. It is true that there is a loan in the name of the plaintiff with the defendant No. 1 but the said loan has no relation with the loan amount decreed in Artha Rin Suit No. 35 of 1996. The cause of action arose on 22-7-2001 when the plaintiff for the first time came to know about the ex-parte judgment and decree dated 12-3-2001 passed in Artha Rin Suit No. 35 of 1996 as such filed the suit for declaration.
